## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `44044d7226a7e875fe42bf1fbac186ec482e72d5`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set of `label-write.mjs` (a seat write tool, not a published package): one new mode, `--release`, relay-only. Every refusal is judged before any write and leaves zero writes: the card not open / without `pm:dispatched` / without an assignee; `--recheck-comment` not on this card or its first line (after heading marks) not `Owned-24h re-check:`; the answer carrying the knock without a readable `Date` header (PREREQUISITE — the age is never this process's clock); the knock younger than `RECLAIM_AFTER_HOURS = 12` (the remainder printed); any comment after the knock (paged to a short page, 30-page cap); `--resume-from BRANCH@SHA` whose branch is missing, whose tip is not that sha, or which has an open PR; a comment file not opening with the `Release:` line (judged by `check-half-states`' own marker) or pre-carrying `Resume-from:`; two `pm:*` states on the target; a route that is not `dispatch` (exit 3, `relay-only`). The stroke is ONE dispatch `comment → labels_add pm:queue → labels_remove pm:dispatched → unassign …`, every action naming the card; no run or a timeout is UNCONFIRMED (exit 6) and never replayed; a failed run is exit 5; a read-back that disagrees is exit 4 and not repaired. Right — and measured on the diff: no added line calls `rest()` with a write verb or `fetch` at all, so the mode has no direct leg by construction.
- The constant lives in two places and the self-test pins them equal by reading `RECLAIM_TEXT_PATH` (`triage-duties.md`); `RELEASE_FROM` / `RELEASE_TO` are pinned members of the imported `PM_EXCLUSIVE_STATE_LABELS`. Right: neither the text nor the tool can drift alone.
- Protocol text (Tier S, `.claude/**`), each file at its ceiling before and after (120 / 96 / 319 / 402 on the head): `triage-duties.md` +4 −3 (the dispatched-card rule rewritten in place with its one exception; the knock; the clock → `label-write.mjs --release`, one relay stroke, seat post untouched; the stroke's four parts); `seat-lifecycle.md:37` → two lines naming the actor (the triage round) and the clock, then the release; `SKILL.md` claim template + one optional `Resume-from:` line; `os-dev.md` rule 1 + one line (a claim carrying `Resume-from` ⇒ build from `origin/BRANCH`, merge `origin/main` first). Every deleted line has a surviving home on `origin/main` (read by `git grep`: the (a) 功能与体验 line and the 承接者 question in `filing-gate.md` / `os-dev.md`; 否决窗口 in `SKILL.md` 升级与决策 and this file's ④; 退场两入口 in `SKILL.md` 入口与角色; 写后读回 in the 四步 pair and `seat-lifecycle.md` 竞态三招; the bare `pnpm install` in rule 1 itself). No re-wrap, no ceiling raise; every prose line ≤ 120 bytes (the widest-table-row pin 342 untouched; the 125-byte line is inside the fenced template).
- The claim template's new line is optional and the lines `post-stamped` reads on a `Claim:` (`Seat:`, `Thread-read:`, `Clause-②:`, `Container & model:`) are untouched. Right.
- Premise: mechanism assumption 5 of the dispatch is falsified on `origin/main` (`git grep 'Owned-24h re-check' origin/main -- .claude scripts/pm` → 0: the knock existed only as triage's live practice) and the fix adds both halves under the spelling triage already uses, one spelling. The card's premise (no actor, no clock, no write path) stands; N = 12 adopted as the named constant.
- Public surface: none. No package publishes any of the five files; `Clause-②: no` is correct.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` on the claim and the PR body; `skip-changeset` is the correct declaration — `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/**` publish nothing. No `.changeset/*.md` touched.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `label-write.mjs` now carries the literal path of `triage-duties.md`, so `dispatch-gates.mjs` derives `check:pm-label-write` for any card touching that file — accepted: an intended coupling, and that battery runs in seconds.
- Git identity: both commits authored and committed by `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (name and e-mail copied from `origin/main`'s tip) with the model-free trailer pair — no deviation.
- The 2,011-case `check:pm-dispatch-gates` battery was re-run on the measured head after the merge of `origin/main` (1,052 s); repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's — `Lint & Repo Gates` `in_progress` on the head at this write, read at landing.
- `--release` wrote nothing live in this run (self-test and dry run only); its first live release is NOT MEASURED until a silent claim exists — the triage seat's to take, and this record says so rather than pretending otherwise.
- `open_questions`: none. Out-of-scope findings (Acceptance notes, nothing filed): `runLabelWrite` step ④ re-adds a stripped label with a direct `POST` even when the stroke went through the relay (pre-existing; the release path reports exit 4 instead) — an observation for the next `label-write` PR, carried on the seat post; the packer's refusal of a session-less envelope is what the relay-only guard makes legible.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-22053-silent-claim-reclaim`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JmWtcHfGbC4ncw4GFKWuRA`

**VERDICT: PASS**
